Excellent in every way
Aug 2026 • Friends
I cannot count how many times I’ve been here, I have an apartment upstairs so it’s very convenient to come here for breakfast lunch or dinner. 
The only dish I ever disliked was the ribs, so I gave it away and ordered something else, problem solved, no complaints. It’s not like anything is expensive here because it’s not. 

In my country, a decent meal will cost five (x5) times what it does here. 

Some of these people online will carry on like it’s the end of the world though. 

Whoever complains about this restaurant is simply full of it. 

The staff is more than friendly. They are all overly polite, including the manager/owner. And the waitresses are all very pretty. 
Tables and silverware are always clean, as they should be. 
And guess what? I’ll be back again tomorrow for the salmon 🍣

Pigsty
Jul 2026 • Family
That's terrible! Tables don't wipe at all!!! There's sauce/salt/spices on one table, there's either no or something selective on the other. The staff doesn't know how to serve the guests any meals! My wife's been served a dish, and I've been waiting for 30 minutes after taking it out and I have to choke on my saliva. Remember, guests are served a dish at the same time! Brought a brusquet, not even plates. How, I'm sorry, should I eat? There's a dirty plate on the table, waiters have come up several times, serving wine, and they haven't reacted! Dishes - first they ordered one, 10 minutes later they come "it's not there, ordered a second, again 10 minutes later "it's not there"... You guys decide for 10 minutes what you have and what you don't have?! Really?! And why don't the waiters know you have dishes in your foot, and the cook does for 10 minutes what he can't tell the waiters about it?! You're well-placed, you should be attracting guests, not alienating! Train the staff and train yourself, otherwise it's nowhere to go! You must understand that poor service is off-putting, and there is no desire to come to you a second time! You have good prices, good food taste, BUT in the pigsty these qualities are lost!!! Delicious food is good in a beautiful place, and when it's served in a barn, it turns into slop! Disgusting!!! Try inviting a restaurant critic... He's going to rain down on you with the worst comments! What a cherry on the cake... They didn't check the score, and only then did they realize that we'd also been fooled for 100,000!

The kitchen experience is extremely mixed.
